connections.stravaBody: Your activities sync on their own while Strava is connected.

connections.telegramBody: Check-ins, coach messages and quick logging come through the bot.
connections.unlinkBody: The bot stops writing to you. You can link again with a new code.

data.ownerCannot: The owner account cannot be deleted here.
